sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被放干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 接着，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: At around 10am on Wednesday, March 26, 1986, 12-year-old Michelle Welch and her two younger sisters left their home in Tacoma, Washington, and headed north.
sentences.zh: 1986年3月26日星期三上午10点左右，12岁的米歇尔·韦尔奇和她两个较小的妹妹离开华盛顿州塔科马的家，朝北走去。

sentences.en: Michelle and 11-year-old Angela were both on their bicycles, while 9-year-old Nicole was
sentences.zh: 米歇尔和11岁的安吉拉都骑着自行车，而9岁的妮可则是

sentences.en: pulled along behind her older sister, wearing roller skates and holding onto a skipping rope they'd tied to Michelle's bike.
sentences.zh: 被姐姐拉着，她踩着旱冰鞋，手里抓着一根绑在米歇尔自行车上的跳绳。

sentences.en: It was a bright, sunny day in the middle of spring break, and Michelle was in charge of her younger sisters while their mother was at work.
sentences.zh: 正值春假期间，阳光明媚，米歇尔在母亲上班时负责照看年幼的妹妹们。

sentences.en: Their destination was Puget Park, a pretty public space with a playground, grassy knolls, and more heavily wooded areas popular with walkers.
sentences.zh: 她们的目的地是皮吉特公园，这是一个美丽的公共场所，有游乐场、草丘，还有许多散步者喜欢去的树木繁茂的区域。

sentences.en: The 1.2-acre park was less than 2 miles from the Welch sisters' home, and only took them a little over 10 minutes to get to.
sentences.zh: 这个1.2英亩的公园距离韦尔奇姐妹的家不到2英里，她们骑车过去只用了短短10多分钟。

sentences.en: The three girls played at the park for over an hour before they started to get hungry.
sentences.zh: 三个女孩在公园里玩了一个多小时才开始觉得饿。

sentences.en: They'd made sandwiches at home so they could have a picnic lunch, but had forgotten to pack them.
sentences.zh: 她们本来在家做好了三明治想当野餐午餐，却忘记带上了。

sentences.en: Michelle, who was a caring and protective big sister, said she'd cycle back home.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔是一个体贴且有保护欲的大姐，她说她要骑车回家一趟。

sentences.en: Angela and Nicole could keep playing, and she would be back with their lunch very soon.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉和妮可可以继续玩，她很快就会带着午餐回来。

sentences.en: Michelle hopped on her bike, leaving Angela and Nicole at the park.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔跳上自行车，把安吉拉和妮可留在公园里。

sentences.en: The minutes ticked by.
sentences.zh: 时间一分一秒地过去。

sentences.en: The two girls noticed that their sister was taking a long time to come back, longer than they would have expected.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩发现姐姐回来花了很长时间，比她们预期的要长。

sentences.en: By around 12.30pm, more than an hour had passed since Michelle left.
sentences.zh: 到中午12点30分左右，距离米歇尔离开已经过去一个多小时了。

sentences.en: Angela and Nicole needed to go to the toilet and couldn't wait any longer, so they left the park to use a restroom at a nearby business.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉和妮可想上厕所，再也等不下去了，于是她们离开公园，去附近一家商业店铺上洗手间。

sentences.en: While there, they also used the phone to call their sister at home.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她们还顺便用电话打给家里的姐姐。

sentences.en: No one picked up.
sentences.zh: 没有人接听。

sentences.en: Angela and Nicole headed back to the park, but still saw no sign of their sister.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉和妮可回到公园，但仍然没有看到姐姐的身影。

sentences.en: They played for a little while at a nearby cave before returning to the playground at around 2pm.
sentences.zh: 她们在一个附近的洞穴里玩了一会儿，大约下午2点才回到游乐场。

sentences.en: There, they noticed something.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她们注意到了一些不对劲。

sentences.en: Michelle's bike was back and secured to a rack close by.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的自行车回来了，锁在附近的一个车架上。

sentences.en: On a picnic table was a lunch bag that had been ripped open.
sentences.zh: 一张野餐桌上放着一个被撕开的午餐袋。

sentences.en: Inside was the food Michelle had gone home to get.
sentences.zh: 里面装着米歇尔回家去拿的食物。

sentences.en: There were some sandwiches, including one that was partially eaten, and a bag of Easter eggs
sentences.zh: 有一些三明治，其中一个吃了一半，还有一袋复活节彩蛋

sentences.en: Michelle had packed as a special treat.
sentences.zh: 是米歇尔特意打包的犒劳。

sentences.en: But there was no sign of Michelle.
sentences.zh: 但不见米歇尔的踪影。

sentences.en: Michelle, something about the scene didn't look right.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔，现场的某种情形看起来不太对劲。

sentences.en: Angela and Nicole called out to their big sister using what the Welchers had dubbed their family call, a loud, distinctive yelp designed to catch each other's attention.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉和妮可大声呼喊她们的大姐，用的韦尔奇家人称之为家庭呼唤的暗号，那是一种响亮而独特的尖叫声，旨在引起彼此的注意。

sentences.en: Michelle didn't return the call.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔没有回应。

sentences.en: At that moment, Angela and Nicole knew that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，安吉拉和妮可知道出事了。

sentences.en: They continued looking for their big sister.
sentences.zh: 她们继续寻找大姐。

sentences.en: Their hopes momentarily soared when they heard someone calling their names, but it turned out to be their babysitter who'd arrived to help.
sentences.zh: 当她们听到有人叫她们的名字时，心中的希望短暂地升腾起来，但结果却是她们的保姆赶来帮忙了。

sentences.en: They had phoned her earlier when they'd gone to the restroom and explained how Michelle wasn't with them.
sentences.zh: 她们之前去洗手间时曾给保姆打过电话，解释了米歇尔不在她们身边的情况。

sentences.en: The babysitter helped look for Michelle and phoned the girl's mother, Barbara.
sentences.zh: 保姆帮忙寻找米歇尔，并给女孩们的母亲芭芭拉打了电话。

sentences.en: Barbara was at work when she received the call.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉接到电话时正在上班。

sentences.en: She was shocked to learn of Michelle's unexplained disappearance.
sentences.zh: 得知米歇尔莫名失踪，她震惊不已。

sentences.en: Michelle had called Barbara just a few hours earlier when she'd returned home to fetch the girls' lunches.
sentences.zh: 就在几个小时前，米歇尔回家给女孩们取午餐时曾给芭芭拉打过电话。

sentences.en: She was asking permission for the three of them to go to Puget Park and then stay there until
sentences.zh: 她请求允许她们三人去皮吉特公园，并在那里待到

sentences.en: Michelle's piano lesson later that day.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候米歇尔的钢琴课。

sentences.en: Barbara had said no, as Michelle's lesson wasn't for another five hours and that seemed too long for her daughters to remain at the park unsupervised.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉拒绝了，因为米歇尔的课还要五个小时才开始，女儿们在公园里无人监管待那么长时间似乎太久了。

sentences.en: Michelle hadn't told her mother that they had already gone to the park or that Angela and
sentences.zh: 米歇尔没有告诉母亲她们已经去过公园，也没有告诉她安吉拉和

sentences.en: Nicole were still there waiting for her return.
sentences.zh: 妮可还在那里等她回来。

sentences.en: Barbara would later surmise that Michelle, who was a responsible and thoughtful girl, must not have wanted her to worry.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉后来猜测，米歇尔是一个懂事体贴的女孩，一定是不想让她担心。

sentences.en: She'd likely assumed that going to the park would have been fine, hence why she'd taken her sisters there first without seeking permission.
sentences.zh: 她大概以为去公园没问题，所以才在没有征得许可的情况下先带妹妹们去了那里。

sentences.en: When Barbara returned home later that day, she found that the house was spotless.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候芭芭拉回到家时，发现家里一尘不染。

sentences.en: It seemed as though Michelle had cleaned it before returning to the park, perhaps as a way
sentences.zh: 看来米歇尔在回公园之前把家里打扫干净了，也许是为了

sentences.en: to soften any anger Barbara might have felt if she'd discovered what her daughters had been up to.
sentences.zh: 如果芭芭拉发现女儿们背着她做了什么而感到生气时，能以此平息怒火。

sentences.en: Terrified, Barbara rushed to Puget Park and called the police.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万分的芭芭拉冲到皮吉特公园并报了警。

sentences.en: Initially, they told her she had to wait 24 hours before reporting her daughter missing, but Barbara was adamant that she needed their help immediately.
sentences.zh: 起初，警方告诉她必须等待24小时才能报告女儿失踪，但芭芭拉坚称她需要他们立刻提供帮助。

sentences.en: By 3.10pm, police officers had descended on Puget Park, along with family and friends of the
sentences.zh: 下午3点10分，警察以及韦尔奇一家的

sentences.en: Welchers.
sentences.zh: 亲友们蜂拥至皮吉特公园。

sentences.en: Over the following hours, police searched the park extensively, accompanied by eight canine officers.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几个小时里，警方在八只警犬的陪同下对公园进行了地毯式搜索。

sentences.en: Dusk arrived and darkness fell, and still the search continued.
sentences.zh: 暮色降临，夜幕低垂，搜寻工作仍在继续。

sentences.en: At 11pm, Michelle's mother Barbara sat waiting in a nearby police car as one of the police dogs honed in on an isolated location about a quarter of a mile from the playground.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点，米歇尔的母亲芭芭拉坐在附近的一辆警车里等待，此时其中一只警犬锁定了一个距离游乐场约四分之一英里的偏僻地点。

sentences.en: A long wooded area dotted with walking trails abutted the eastern side of Puget Park.
sentences.zh: 皮吉特公园东侧紧邻着一块长满步行小径的狭长林区。

sentences.en: This area was half a mile long and known as the Gulch.
sentences.zh: 这片区域长达半英里，被称为峡谷。

sentences.en: The dog had been focused on the Gulch when it headed off a trail and indicated at a spot about 60 yards into the woods where a makeshift fire pit had been crafted.
sentences.zh: 警犬一直在搜寻峡谷，随后它偏离了一条小径，并在深入树林约60码处的一个临时火坑旁停下做出了标记。

sentences.en: Hidden amongst the grassy vegetation was the body of 12-year-old Michelle Welch.
sentences.zh: 在草丛 vegetation 中藏着12岁米歇尔·韦尔奇的尸体。

sentences.en: She lay on her back with her arms outstretched either side, her hands muddy and tightly clenched.
sentences.zh: 她仰面躺着，双臂向两侧伸展，双手沾满泥土且紧紧握拳。

sentences.en: She wore a white shirt and a tan jumper which had been pulled up to expose her upper abdomen.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件白衬衫和一件棕褐色套头衫，衣服被往上拉，露出了上腹部。

sentences.en: There was blood on the clothing.
sentences.zh: 衣服上有血迹。

sentences.en: Michelle was naked from the waist down, though she still wore her socks pulled up to her knees.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔腰部以下赤裸，不过她仍然穿着拉到膝盖的袜子。

sentences.en: Her left sneaker had been pulled off.
sentences.zh: 她的左运动鞋被脱掉了。

sentences.en: Michelle's pink trousers and her underpants had been pulled down her body and were tangled inside out around one ankle.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的粉红色裤子和内裤被褪到身体下方，杂乱地翻转着缠绕在一个脚踝上。

sentences.en: There was no sign of the pink framed eyeglasses she had been wearing earlier.
sentences.zh: 不见她之前戴的粉红色框架眼镜的踪迹。

sentences.en: The right side of Michelle's head had been fatally struck with a blunt object.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔头部的右侧遭到钝器致命击打。

sentences.en: Her throat was also slit and she had a defensive wound to one hand.
sentences.zh: 她的喉咙也被割断，一只手上有一处防御性伤口。

sentences.en: The suspect's semen and pubic hair were recovered from the scene, confirming that Michelle had been sexually assaulted.
sentences.zh: 现场提取到了嫌疑人的精液和阴毛，证实米歇尔遭到性侵。

sentences.en: As police lifted her body, they found a folding pocket knife with a sheath under her right leg.
sentences.zh: 当警察抬起她的尸体时，他们在她的右腿下方发现了一把带鞘的折叠口袋刀。

sentences.en: A small length of cord was discovered hanging from a nearby branch.
sentences.zh: 附近树枝上挂着一小段绳索。

sentences.en: Michelle's coat had also been draped from a bush.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的外套也被搭在灌木丛上。

sentences.en: It was covered in blood, indicating the killer removed it after the murder.
sentences.zh: 上面沾满了血迹，表明凶手是在谋杀后才脱下它的。

sentences.en: When Barbara Leonard was informed that Michelle's body had been found, she went into a state of shock and had to be taken to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 当芭芭拉·伦纳德得知米歇尔的尸体被找到时，她陷入了休克状态，不得不被送往医院。

sentences.en: Without the police saying anything else, she knew that her daughter had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 无需警察多说，她就知道女儿已经遇害了。

sentences.en: As she recalled years later in an interview with the television program Dateline, quote, You know when you say found a body, it's not a person.
sentences.zh: 正如她多年后在接受电视节目《日界线》采访时回忆的那样，原话是：“你知道当你听说找到一具尸体时，那已经不是一个人了。”

sentences.en: It's terrible.
sentences.zh: “这太可怕了。”

sentences.en: Investigators suspected that Michelle had become worried after returning to Puget Park to find her sisters gone.
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑米歇尔回到皮吉特公园发现妹妹们不见了之后开始感到担忧。

sentences.en: She might have headed along the Gulch Trail in search of them and had been attacked by someone there.
sentences.zh: 她可能沿着峡谷小径去寻找她们，并在那里遭到某人的袭击。

sentences.en: Another possibility was that her killer had seen her looking for the girls and opportunistically told her that he knew where they were.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能是她的凶手看到她在找女孩们，便趁机告诉她他知道她们在哪里。

sentences.en: He had then lured Michelle into the highly isolated fire pit location within the Gulch.
sentences.zh: 然后，他把米歇尔引诱到峡谷内那个极度偏僻的火坑所在地。

sentences.en: Michelle had been found with a small cut to her cheek, which could have been made with a knife.
sentences.zh: 人们发现米歇尔的脸颊上有一道小切口，这可能是用刀造成的。

sentences.en: Her killer might have held the knife to Michelle's face as a threat while forcing her through the Gulch.
sentences.zh: 她的凶手可能在强行穿过峡谷时用刀抵住米歇尔的脸作为威胁。

sentences.en: Michelle's family could think of no one who would want to harm her.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的家人想不出有谁会想要伤害她。

sentences.en: Detectives took possession of some notebooks that had belonged to the 12-year-old and scoured Michelle's writings and drawings for clues.
sentences.zh: 侦探们拿到了属于这名12女孩的一些笔记本，并在米歇尔的文字和涂鸦中搜寻线索。

sentences.en: They found nothing of significance.
sentences.zh: 他们没有发现任何有价值的线索。

sentences.en: Detectives appealed to the public for information.
sentences.zh: 侦探们向公众呼吁提供线索。

sentences.en: Although no one had witnessed Michelle's abduction, a 15-year-old skateboarder had almost certainly seen the moments right before it.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有人目击米歇尔被绑架，但一名15岁的滑板少年几乎可以肯定看到了案发前的那一刻。

sentences.en: He'd spotted Michelle at about 1.30pm walking around as though looking for someone.
sentences.zh: 他在下午1点30分左右看到米歇尔四处走动，像是在找人。

sentences.en: She then headed back to the picnic table where she'd placed her sister's lunches.
sentences.zh: 然后她走回放着她妹妹午餐的野餐桌。

sentences.en: The 15-year-old left to use the bathroom and when he returned just a couple of minutes later,
sentences.zh: 这名15岁的少年离开去上厕所，当他几分钟后回来时，

sentences.en: Michelle was gone.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔已经不见了。

sentences.en: A number of sightings of suspicious men trickled in.
sentences.zh: 关于可疑男子的目击情报零星传了进来。

sentences.en: One of Michelle's classmates who'd been at the park that day noticed a man watching the three Welch sisters.
sentences.zh: 那天在公园里的米歇尔的一个同学注意到一个男子在盯着三个韦尔奇姐妹。

sentences.en: The man appeared to be in his mid-twenties, was short and wore dirty, ripped clothing.
sentences.zh: 该男子看起来二十岁出头，身材矮小，穿着肮脏破烂的衣服。

sentences.en: A teacher who knew Michelle from school saw the 12-year-old talking to a young man with olive skin and dark hair.
sentences.zh: 一位在学校认识米歇尔的老师看到这名12岁的女孩正和一个皮肤呈橄榄色、留着黑发的年轻男子说话。

sentences.en: He was pointing down towards the gulch.
sentences.zh: 他正指着下方峡谷的方向。

sentences.en: A short while later, a boy heard what sounded like a girl screaming.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，一个男孩听到了一声听起来像女孩尖叫的声音。

sentences.en: He'd thought nothing of it, as children often screamed while playing at the park.
sentences.zh: 他当时没放在心上，因为孩子们在公园玩耍时经常尖叫。

sentences.en: A woman reported seeing a shifty-looking man exiting the gulch that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一位女士报告说，那天下午看到一个形迹可疑的男子从峡谷出来。

sentences.en: The man moved quickly and appeared to be in a rush to leave the park.
sentences.zh: 这名男子行动迅速，似乎急着离开公园。

sentences.en: He was white, tall and lean and between 35 and 40 years old, with short, dark blonde hair.
sentences.zh: 他是白人，身材高大清瘦，年龄在35到40岁之间，留着短短的深金黄色头发。

sentences.en: A composite sketch of this individual was made and shared with the media.
sentences.zh: 警方绘制了此人的合成画像并在媒体上公布。

sentences.en: Some local teenagers said they knew of several men who lived in the gulch and often sat and smoked beneath the nearby Proctor Street Bridge.
sentences.zh: 一些当地青少年表示，他们知道有几个男人住在峡谷里，经常坐在附近的普罗クター街桥下抽烟。

sentences.en: On one occasion, one of the men had chased a teen while brandishing an air pistol.
sentences.zh: 有一次，其中一名男子挥舞着一把气手枪追赶一名青少年。

sentences.en: An employee of the Metropolitan Park District also came forward to report that she'd seen a strange man lurking around the gulch trail two weeks before Michelle's murder.
sentences.zh: 大都会公园区的一名员工也前来报告称，在米歇尔遇害前两周，她看到一个陌生男子在峡谷小径附近潜伏。

sentences.en: The man had been walking along the trail, but each time he saw the employee, he ducked away into the heavy brush that grew next to the path.
sentences.zh: 这名男子沿着小径行走，但每次看到这名员工，他都会躲进小径旁生长茂密的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: After reaching the end of the trail, he turned around and walked back again.
sentences.zh: 走到小径尽头后，他又转身走了回来。

sentences.en: Another composite sketch was made from this sighting, depicting a white man in his 30s or 40s with dark hair parted to the right and a bushy moustache.
sentences.zh: 根据这次目击事件绘制了另一张合成画像，描绘了一名30多岁或40多岁的白人男子，留着右分头的黑发，蓄着浓密的胡子。

sentences.en: In the weeks that followed, investigators received numerous calls and reports from people who recognised the suspect sketches.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，调查人员收到了许多电话和报告，都是认出嫌疑人画像的人。

sentences.en: One tip-off came from a jogger who said he had seen the suspect hanging around another Tacoma Park called Point Defiance Park, located about 3.5 miles northwest of Puget Park.
sentences.zh: 其中一条线索来自一名慢跑者，他说他看到嫌疑人在塔科马的另一个公园——点登凡斯公园闲逛，该公园位于皮吉特公园西北约3.5英里处。

sentences.en: Police interrogated every known sex offender who lived in the area, but all were eliminated from the investigation.
sentences.zh: 警方讯问了该地区所有已知的性犯罪者，但他们都从调查中被排除了。

sentences.en: The brutal killing had terrified Tacoma residents.
sentences.zh: 这场残忍的谋杀案吓坏了塔科马居民。

sentences.en: Some members of the public began calling for lighting to be installed in Puget Park, along with a fence to separate the gulch from the rest of the space.
sentences.zh: 一些公众开始呼吁在皮吉特公园安装照明设施，并修建一道栅栏将峡谷与公园的其他区域隔开。

sentences.en: A community group called Friends of Tacoma Parks also launched a watch program at
sentences.zh: 一个名为塔科马公园之友的社区组织也在

sentences.en: Puget Park to improve public safety.
sentences.zh: 皮吉特公园启动了一项巡逻计划，以改善公共安全。

sentences.en: Many of Michelle's classmates were among the 200 mourners who attended her funeral and were driven there in a yellow school bus.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的许多同学都在出席她葬礼的200名哀悼者之列，他们是坐着黄色校车被送到那里的。

sentences.en: Michelle was remembered as a girl who loved art, music and writing.
sentences.zh: 人们记忆中的米歇尔是一个热爱艺术、音乐和写作的女孩。

sentences.en: She was a quieter child who was almost always seen reading a book.
sentences.zh: 她是个比较安静的孩子，几乎总是看到她在看书。

sentences.en: Michelle's aunt told those assembled.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的姑姑对聚集在那里的众人说。

sentences.en: She lived in her stories and drawings.
sentences.zh: 她活在自己的故事和画作中。

sentences.en: Now, she'll live on in the dreams of magic and light.
sentences.zh: 现在，她将永远活在魔法与光明的梦想中。

sentences.en: One of Michelle's friends performed a piano melody that the two had previously played together as a duet.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的一位朋友演奏了一首钢琴曲，两人以前曾合奏过这首曲子。

sentences.en: In the weeks following Michelle's murder, the police investigation stalled as each tip-off led to another dead end.
sentences.zh: 在米歇尔遇害后的几周里，由于每条线索都陷入死胡同，警方调查陷入停滞。

sentences.en: A $5,000 reward for information leading to the arrest of Michelle's killer went unclaimed.
sentences.zh: 悬赏5,000美元征集能导致逮捕米歇尔凶手的线索无人认领。

sentences.en: Weeks turned to months and the case began to go cold.
sentences.zh: 数周变成数月，案件开始变冷。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持

sentences.en: File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 档案继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: On Monday, August 4, 1986, a 13-year-old
sentences.zh: 1986年8月4日星期一，一名13岁的

sentences.en: Tacoma resident named Jennifer Bastion decided to go for a ride on her brand new champagne-coloured
sentences.zh: 塔科马居民名叫詹妮弗·巴斯蒂安，她决定骑着她那辆崭新的香槟色

sentences.en: 18-speed Schwinn bicycle.
sentences.zh: 18速施温自行车去兜风。

sentences.en: Jennifer, who was on her summer break from school, was a keen cyclist and was set to participate in an upcoming long-distance ride on the San Juan Islands.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗正值暑假，是一名热心的自行车手，准备参加即将到来的一场在圣胡安群岛的长途骑行活动。

sentences.en: As part of her training for this ride, she often cycled the three-mile journey from her home to Point Defiance Park,
sentences.zh: 作为这项骑行训练的一部分，她经常骑车走完从家到点登凡斯公园的3英里路程，

sentences.en: a 760-acre space with a zoo, a beach, an off-leash dog park, and roughly 400 acres of old-growth foreSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一个占地760英亩的公园，拥有动物园、海滩、无绳遛狗公园以及大约400英亩的原始森林。

sentences.en: The park sits at the north end of Tacoma on the point of the Kitsap Peninsula, and its five-mile-drive bike trail was ideal for cycling.
sentences.zh: 该公园位于基萨普半岛尖端的塔科马北端，其五英里车程的自行车道非常适合骑行。

sentences.en: Normally, Jennifer trained with a riding buddy, but on that particular day, her cycling partner was unavailable.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，詹妮弗会和骑友一起训练，但在那特定的一天，她的骑行伙伴没空。

sentences.en: Jennifer got permission to go for a solo ride instead and left a note for her parents, letting them know she'd be home by 6.30pm.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗得到了独自骑行的许可，并给父母留了一张便条，让他们知道她将在傍晚6点30分前回家。

sentences.en: It was 2.30pm when she departed.
sentences.zh: 她出发时是下午2点30分。

sentences.en: Four hours later, Jennifer's father Ralph noticed that she wasn't yet home as promised.
sentences.zh: 四个小时后，詹妮弗的父亲拉尔夫发现她还没有像承诺的那样回家。

sentences.en: He went out with some neighbours to search the surrounding streets, but there was no sign of his daughter.
sentences.zh: 他带着一些邻居出去搜寻周围的街道，但没有女儿的踪迹。

sentences.en: Ralph travelled the route that Jennifer was known to ride to Point
sentences.zh: 拉尔夫沿着詹妮弗众所周知的骑行路线前往点

sentences.en: Defiance Park and found no trace of her there either.
sentences.zh: Defiance Park，在那里同样没有找到她的踪迹。

sentences.en: He alerted his wife, Patty, who raced home from work to help.
sentences.zh: 他通知了他的妻子帕蒂，帕蒂从工作地点赶回家中帮忙。

sentences.en: At 8.30pm, the Bastions reported their 13-year-old daughter missing.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点30分，巴斯蒂安夫妇报警称他们13岁的女儿失踪了。

sentences.en: Police immediately took the call seriously.
sentences.zh: 警方立即高度重视这起报警。

sentences.en: It had only been a little over four months since 12-year-old Michelle Welch was murdered.
sentences.zh: 此时距离12岁的米歇尔·韦尔奇被谋杀仅仅过去四个多月。

sentences.en: Now, another young girl had vanished after heading to different Tacoma Park lands that was only three miles away from Puget Park.
sentences.zh: 现在，又有一个年轻女孩在前往距离普吉特公园仅三英里的塔科马公园不同区域后失踪了。

sentences.en: Officers immediately set out to look for Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 警员们立即出发寻找珍妮弗。

sentences.en: And by 1am, two sniffer dogs and their handlers had also joined in.
sentences.zh: 到了凌晨1点，两只搜救犬及其训导员也加入了搜寻。

sentences.en: The dogs were given articles of
sentences.zh: 搜救犬被给予了

sentences.en: Jennifer's clothing to smell and tracked her from her home to Point Defiance Park.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗的衣物进行气味辨别，并一路追踪她的气味从家来到了Point Defiance公园。

sentences.en: They continued to pick up her scent on the park's five-mile drive trail, but didn't find Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 它们继续在公园五英里景观大道的小径上捕捉到了她的气味，但并没有找到珍妮弗。

sentences.en: Witness sightings allowed investigators to pinpoint Jennifer's last known locations and movements, as well as confirm what she had been wearing.
sentences.zh: 目击者的证词帮助调查人员确定了珍妮弗最后已知的地点和行踪，并确认了她当时的穿着。

sentences.en: A blue or purple one-piece swimsuit, shorts, and a white bike helmet with red stripes.
sentences.zh: 一件蓝色或紫色的连体泳衣、短裤，以及一顶带红条纹的白色自行车头盔。

sentences.en: Between 2.30 and 3pm that day, a park employee had seen
sentences.zh: 当天下午2点30分到3点之间，一名公园员工曾看到

sentences.en: Jennifer bike riding near the Point Defiance Park entrance.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗在Point Defiance公园入口附近骑自行车。

sentences.en: At 4.10pm, three boys who knew Jennifer passed by her on five-mile drive.
sentences.zh: 下午4点10分，三个认识珍妮弗的男孩在五英里景观大道上与她擦肩而过。

sentences.en: They noticed she was being closely followed by another cyclist, a white man who wore mirrored sunglasses.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到她正被另一名骑车人紧紧尾随，那是一个戴着镜面太阳镜的白人男子。

sentences.en: He seemed to echo Jennifer's movements, speeding up and slowing down whenever she did so.
sentences.zh: 他似乎在模仿珍妮弗的举动，每当她加速或减速时，他也跟着加速或减速。

sentences.en: Jennifer appeared unaware of the man's strange behaviour.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗似乎并没有察觉到这名男子的异常举动。

sentences.en: Several more witnesses had spotted Jennifer over the next couple of hours, with the final sighting taking place at 6pm.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个小时里，又有几位目击者看到了珍妮弗，最后一次目击发生在下午6点。

sentences.en: A woman had seen her riding near what was known as the bowl area of the park.
sentences.zh: 一位女士看到她骑车经过公园内被称为碗状区域的地方。

sentences.en: Over the next three days, police officers scoured the area in search of the missing 13-year-old.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的三天里，警员们在该地区进行拉网式搜查，寻找这名失踪的13岁女孩。

sentences.en: Roughly 230 searchers from numerous counties assisted.
sentences.zh: 来自众多县市的大约230名搜查人员参与了协助。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the Bastion family and their friends stood at the park's entrance, handing out missing persons flyers to passers-by.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，巴斯蒂安一家和他们的朋友站在公园入口处，向过往行人分发寻人传单。

sentences.en: Paddy Bastion worked for a telecommunications company, which provided four cell phones to be used by the command centre, facilitating easier communication during the search.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·巴斯蒂安是一家电信公司的员工，该公司提供了四部手机供指挥中心使用，以便在搜寻期间进行更顺畅的沟通。

sentences.en: But no trace of Jennifer, or the new bike she was so proud of, was found.
sentences.zh: 但没有找到任何关于珍妮弗或她引以为傲的新自行车的踪迹。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, police, the public and the media began drawing comparisons to the Michelle Welch case.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，警方、公众和媒体就开始将此案与米歇尔·韦尔奇案进行对比。

sentences.en: Both girls had disappeared after riding their bikes to a Tacoma park.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩都是在骑自行车前往塔科马的一座公园后失踪的。

sentences.en: They were just one year apart in age and even looked similar, both with blonde hair and blue eyes, though Michelle had long hair, while
sentences.zh: 她们的年龄只相差一岁，甚至长相也很相似，都拥有金发和蓝眼睛，不过米歇尔留着长发，而

sentences.en: Jennifer wore hers short.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗留着短发。

sentences.en: A key difference was that Michelle was found in the park she had been visiting just hours after disappearing, while officers had scoured Point Defiance Park for days
sentences.zh: 一个关键的区别在于，米歇尔在失踪几小时后就在她去过的公园里被找到了，而警员们在Point Defiance公园搜寻了好几天

sentences.en: with no trace of Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 却找不到珍妮弗的丝毫踪迹。

sentences.en: Days turned to weeks and there was still no sign of the missing 13-year-old.
sentences.zh: 日子一天天过去，变成了数周，这位失踪的13岁女孩依然杳无音信。

sentences.en: Posters alerting people to Jennifer's disappearance were displayed all along the route from her home to Point Defiance Park, asking anyone who knew anything to report it.
sentences.zh: 提醒人们注意珍妮弗失踪的海报贴满了从她家到Point Defiance公园的沿途，呼吁任何知情者举报。

sentences.en: Psychics and members of the public called in to report possible tip-offs.
sentences.zh: 灵媒和热心公众纷纷打电话提供可能的线索。

sentences.en: None of these led anywhere.
sentences.zh: 这些线索全都没有任何结果。

sentences.en: Still, Jennifer's family held out hope.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，珍妮弗的家人依然抱有一线希望。

sentences.en: Shortly after Jennifer went missing, the Bastions were visited at home by Michelle Welch's mother,
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗失踪后不久，米歇尔·韦尔奇的母亲

sentences.en: Barbara, and her sister.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉及其姐姐来到巴斯蒂安家中拜访。

sentences.en: Barbara was all too aware of the pain the Bastions were enduring and wanted to share her sympathy as well as her hope that Jennifer would be returned to them unharmed.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉对巴斯蒂安夫妇承受的痛苦感同身受，她希望表达同情，同时也希望珍妮弗能完好无损地回到他们身边。

sentences.en: Patty Bastion was touched by Barbara's kind gesture and found her to be very nice.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·巴斯蒂安被芭芭拉的善意举动所触动，觉得她非常善良。

sentences.en: However, she struggled to understand why Barbara had visited, because she believed Jennifer's case was very different to Michelle's.
sentences.zh: 然而，她很难理解芭芭拉为什么要来，因为她认为珍妮弗的案子和米歇尔的完全不同。

sentences.en: After Barbara left, Patty turned to a friend who was sitting beside her and said.
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉离开后，帕蒂转向坐在身旁的一位朋友说。

sentences.en: I'm not sure why she came.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她为什么来。

sentences.en: Jennifer's not dead.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗没有死。

sentences.en: On Tuesday August 26, just over three weeks since Jennifer went missing, police received a tip-off from a man who'd been out jogging in Point Defiance Park with a running club.
sentences.zh: 8月26日星期二，即珍妮弗失踪三周多后，警方接到了一名男子的线索，他曾与一个跑步俱乐部一起在Point Defiance公园慢跑。

sentences.en: Their route had taken them along Five Mile Drive and the man had noticed a foul odor.
sentences.zh: 他们的路线经过五英里景观大道，该男子注意到了一股恶臭。

sentences.en: Park Police and members of the Tacoma Police Department were dispatched to the location, along with a sniffer dog, but couldn't find the source of the smell.
sentences.zh: 公园警察和塔科马警察局的成员被派往该地点，并带了一只搜救犬，但未能找到气味的来源。

sentences.en: Still, they continued to focus on the general location.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们仍继续将重点放在该大致区域。

sentences.en: Two days later, on Thursday August 28, a German Shepherd search dog honed in on a wooded area off Five Mile Drive.
sentences.zh: 两天后的8月28日星期四，一只德国牧羊犬搜救犬锁定了一处位于五英里景观大道旁的林区。

sentences.en: It was about 150 feet from the path and positioned between the road and the peninsula's cliffs.
sentences.zh: 它距离小路约150英尺，位于道路和半岛悬崖之间。

sentences.en: The dog led searchers to a spot that was difficult to reach due to the dense vegetation.
sentences.zh: 警犬引导搜查人员来到一处由于植被茂密而很难到达的地点。

sentences.en: On closer inspection, the location was a kind of hollowed-out cave in the ground, hidden from view by the trees and brush.
sentences.zh: 走近细看，这个地方原来是地面上一个类似掏空的山洞，被树木和灌木丛遮挡得严严实实。

sentences.en: It looked as though it had been prepared ahead of time by someone who knew the park's woods and trails extremely well.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是对公园树林和步道极其熟悉的人提前准备好的。

sentences.en: Officers had to climb down into the cave-like space in order to see inside.
sentences.zh: 警员们必须爬进这个洞穴状的空间才能看清里面的情况。

sentences.en: There lay the body of a young girl.
sentences.zh: 那里躺着一个年轻女孩的尸体。

sentences.en: It was Jennifer Bastion.
sentences.zh: 正是珍妮弗·巴斯蒂安。

sentences.en: She was lying on her back with her legs apart and arms outstretched.
sentences.zh: 她仰面躺着，双腿分开，双臂伸展。

sentences.en: Her swimsuit and shorts had been pulled down around her right ankle.
sentences.zh: 她的泳衣和短裤被拉到了右脚踝处。

sentences.en: She still wore her socks, shoes and bicycle gloves.
sentences.zh: 她仍然穿着袜子、鞋子和自行车手套。

sentences.en: Her state of undress and the way her body had been posed implied that she had been sexually assaulted, but her remains were too decomposed to confirm whether
sentences.zh: 她未着衣物的状态以及尸体摆放的姿势暗示她曾遭受性侵，但她的遗体腐烂程度太高，无法确认

sentences.en: or not she had been raped.
sentences.zh: 她是否遭到强奸。

sentences.en: A ligature made from a thin rope was found around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她的脖子上缠着一根细绳做成的勒索绳。

sentences.en: Her state of decomposition prevented investigators from conclusively determining whether there were other injuries, but it appeared her throat may have been cut as well.
sentences.zh: 遗体的腐烂程度阻碍调查人员最终确定是否存在其他伤害，但她的喉咙似乎也曾被割开。

sentences.en: She was missing a tooth, suggesting her killer might have inflicted blunt force trauma.
sentences.zh: 她缺了一颗牙齿，这表明凶手可能施加了钝器暴力。

sentences.en: Jennifer's cause of death was determined to be asphyxia, secondary to strangulation.
sentences.zh: 经判定，珍妮弗的死因是窒息，继发于勒颈。

sentences.en: Her bicycle was discovered lying on its side in some brush, further towards the cliffs.
sentences.zh: 她的自行车被发现侧躺在靠近悬崖方向的一些灌木丛中。

sentences.en: It had been covered with fern fronds that had since died and turned brown.
sentences.zh: 它上面盖着已经枯萎变褐的蕨类植物叶子。

sentences.en: Jennifer's blue bike saddlebag was still attached, with her white and red striped bike helmet inside.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗蓝色的自行车鞍囊依然挂在车上，里面装着她红白相间的自行车头盔。

sentences.en: Other contents included a water bottle, some clothing, a bike manual and Jennifer's pink and black velcro wallet with $3 and some loose change inside.
sentences.zh: 其他物品包括一个水壶、一些衣物、一本自行车手册以及珍妮弗的粉黑相间魔术贴钱包，里面有3美元和一些零钱。

sentences.en: Detectives faced the difficult task of informing the Bastions that their daughter had been found.
sentences.zh: 侦探们面临着一项艰难的任务，那就是通知巴斯蒂安夫妇他们的女儿被找到了。

sentences.en: Patty Bastion was at home painting the living room's walls when there was a knock on the front door.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂·巴斯蒂安当时正在家里粉刷客厅的墙壁，这时前门传来了敲门声。

sentences.en: She would later tell Dateline journalist Keith
sentences.zh: 她后来对《日界线》记者基思·

sentences.en: Morrison that she could not bear to think of what had happened to her daughter, stating,
sentences.zh: 莫里森说，她不忍去想女儿遭遇了什么，并表示，

sentences.en: I have my fairy tale, I think, and I'll just live with it.
sentences.zh: 我想我有我的童话故事，我愿意就这样生活在其中。

sentences.en: She was riding her bike, the monster came out of the woods and grabbed her and killed her.
sentences.zh: 她当时在骑自行车，那个恶魔从树林里冲出来抓住了她并杀害了她。

sentences.en: More than that, I can't wrap my brain around.
sentences.zh: 除此之外的事情，我的大脑无法理解。

sentences.en: Right away, the public began to speculate that Michelle Welch and Jennifer Bastion had been killed by the same man.
sentences.zh: 公众立刻开始猜测，米歇尔·韦尔奇和珍妮弗·巴斯蒂安是被同一个人杀害的。

sentences.en: Child abductions and murders were rare in Tacoma, and now there had been two under disturbingly similar circumstances within mere months of each other.
sentences.zh: 儿童绑架和谋杀案在塔科马极为罕见，而现在在短短几个月内，却在令人不安的相似情况下发生了两起。

sentences.en: Fear spread that there was a serial killer stalking Tacoma's parks and preying on girls.
sentences.zh: 人们开始恐慌，担心有一个连环杀手在塔科马的公园里潜伏并以女孩为猎物。

sentences.en: When asked whether this was the case, law enforcement officers were cagey, merely stating that at this point in time they had no physical evidence linking the two cases.
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否如此时，执法人员态度含糊，仅仅表示目前他们没有将两起案件联系起来的物证。

sentences.en: But, behind closed doors, it was a different story.
sentences.zh: 但在私下里，情况则完全不同。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, investigators drew the conclusion that the two girls were victims of the same perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，调查人员就得出结论，两个女孩是同一个凶手的受害者。

sentences.en: In addition to the similarities of their age, appearance, and the circumstances of
sentences.zh: 除了在年龄、外貌以及

sentences.en: their disappearances, their bodies had been found posed in almost the same way, on their backs with their legs apart and arms outstretched.
sentences.zh: 失踪情况上的相似之处外，她们的尸体被发现时摆放的姿势几乎完全相同：仰面躺着，双腿分开，双臂伸展。

sentences.en: Both were exposed, with articles of clothing left in disarray around their ankles.
sentences.zh: 两人身体裸露，衣物杂乱地堆在脚踝周围。

sentences.en: Their remains had been hidden in wooded, isolated areas.
sentences.zh: 她们的遗体都被藏在树木繁茂、人迹罕至的区域。

sentences.en: Jennifer had a rope ligature around her neck, while a cord was found, though not used, at Michelle's scene.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗的脖子上缠着一根绳索，而在米歇尔的案发现场也发现了一根绳子，不过没有使用。

sentences.en: Michelle had definitely had her neck cut, and it was possible Jennifer had as well.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的脖子确实被割开过，珍妮弗也很有可能是这种情况。

sentences.en: Initially, it was wondered whether the two murders could have been committed by an as-yet-unidentified serial killer who'd been dubbed the Green River Killer.
sentences.zh: 起初，人们怀疑这两起谋杀案是否是一个尚未被确认的、被称为“绿河杀手”的连环杀手所为。

sentences.en: The Green River Killer had been operating around the Tacoma and Seattle areas since four years earlier in 1982.
sentences.zh: “绿河杀手”早在四年前的1982年起就在塔科马和西雅图一带作案。

sentences.en: By 1984, he had already killed five women and girls, and a special task force was formed to handle the case.
sentences.zh: 到1984年，他已经杀害了五名妇女和女孩，为此专门成立了一个特别工作组来处理此案。

sentences.en: Investigators consulted renowned FBI profiler
sentences.zh: 调查人员咨询了著名的FBI行为分析专家

sentences.en: John Douglas, and even spoke with convicted serial killer Ted Bundy in an attempt to build a picture of their suspect.
sentences.zh: 约翰·道格拉斯，甚至与已定罪的连环杀手特德·邦迪进行了交谈，试图勾勒出嫌疑人的画像。

sentences.en: Following Michelle and Jennifer's murders, the Green River Killer task force took a look at their cases, but they were deemed to have been committed by somebody else.
sentences.zh: 在米歇尔和珍妮弗被谋杀后，“绿河杀手”工作组审阅了她们的案件，但认为这些案件是其他人所为。

sentences.en: A new task force was formed to coordinate the Welch and Bastion cases.
sentences.zh: 为此成立了一个新的工作组来协调韦尔奇案和巴斯蒂安案。

sentences.en: Thousands of tips poured in from the public, and detectives interviewed hundreds of persons of interest, collecting their hair, blood, and saliva as well.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的线索从公众中涌入，侦探们讯问了数百名涉案人员，并收集了他们的头发、血液和唾液。

sentences.en: One man soon came under scrutiny as their prime suspect.
sentences.zh: 很快，一名男子进入视线，成为他们的头号嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Multiple people had reported him as a creeper who was known to sunbathe nude at Point Defiance Park.
sentences.zh: 多名目击者举报他是一个行为诡异的人，喜欢在Point Defiance公园赤身裸体日光浴。

sentences.en: He drove a van and possessed strange drawings of young girls.
sentences.zh: 他开着一辆面包车，并且藏有年轻女孩的怪异画作。

sentences.en: Hair and blood samples subsequently ruled him out.
sentences.zh: 随后的毛发和血液样本排除了他的嫌疑。

sentences.en: Despite the abundance of calls from the public, none of the tips resulted in an arreSt. Numerous suspects were identified, interviewed, and deemed plausible,
sentences.zh: 尽管公众打来的电话络绎不绝，但没有一条线索导致逮捕。许多嫌疑人被识别、讯问并被认为合理，

sentences.en: before later being cleared.
sentences.zh: 但在后来都被洗脱了嫌疑。

sentences.en: If a suspect seemed likely for one of the cases but had an alibi for the other, he was ruled out.
sentences.zh: 如果某个嫌疑人看起来符合其中一起案件，但对另一起案件有不在场证明，他就会被排除。

sentences.en: Several times a prime suspect came into focus, only to ultimately be eliminated for one reason or another.
sentences.zh: 有好几次，头号嫌疑人进入人们的视线，但最终因这样或那样的原因被排除。

sentences.en: Months continued to pass and assumed the first anniversary of Michelle Welch's murder arrived, closely followed by that of Jennifer Bastion.
sentences.zh: 几个月继续过去，米歇尔·韦尔奇遇害一周年纪念日来临，珍妮弗·巴斯蒂安的周年纪念日也紧随其后。

sentences.en: By this time, the task force had been disbanded, but two detectives still regularly checked in on the case and evidence from the crime scenes was still being processed.
sentences.zh: 此时，工作组已经解散，但仍有两名侦探定期跟进此案，犯罪现场的证据也仍在处理中。

sentences.en: When speaking to the media, law enforcement spokespeople were adamant that the investigation was still very much active and ongoing.
sentences.zh: 在向媒体发言时，执法部门发言人坚称调查仍在积极且持续地进行。

sentences.en: In 1989, three years after the murders, investigators sent the semen sample from Michelle's murder to a private laboratory in California for testing.
sentences.zh: 1989年，即谋杀案发生三年后，调查人员将米歇尔谋杀案中的精液样本送到加利福尼亚的一家私人实验室进行检测。

sentences.en: DNA profiling was still in its infancy when it came to use in criminal investigations, with the first conviction based on DNA evidence having taken place in 1987.
sentences.zh: 在刑事调查中，DNA分型技术当时仍处于起步阶段，首例基于DNA证据的定罪发生在1987年。

sentences.en: The California lab sent back the killer's profile, though there was no database for investigators to compare it to.
sentences.zh: 加州实验室寄回了凶手的DNA档案，尽管调查人员没有可供比对的数据库。

sentences.en: Instead, they used it to rule out any potential suspects that emerged.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们用它来排除任何新出现的潜在嫌疑人。

sentences.en: By the mid-naughties, a more sophisticated DNA profile of the killer was created.
sentences.zh: 到本世纪第一个十年中期，一个更加复杂的凶手DNA档案被建立起来。

sentences.en: By this time, there were state and federal databases that detectives could check the profile againSt. Yet, they couldn't find a match.
sentences.zh: 此时，已经有了侦探们可以用来再次比对该DNA档案的国家和联邦数据库。然而，他们依然没有找到匹配对象。

sentences.en: Whoever the killer was, he seemingly didn't have a serious criminal history.
sentences.zh: 无论凶手是谁，他似乎没有严重的犯罪前科。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered if the killer had been in the military and was now living far away elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 调查人员纳闷，凶手是否曾参军并在其他遥远的地方生活。

sentences.en: Or perhaps he'd died before he could commit any more murders.
sentences.zh: 或者他可能在犯下更多谋杀案之前就已经死了。

sentences.en: Without any arrests in their daughter's cases, the victims' families did their best to continue living.
sentences.zh: 由于女儿的案件迟迟未能破案，受害者家属尽最大努力继续生活。

sentences.en: Michelle's mother, Barbara, took solace in her Christian faith and staunch belief that she would one day be reunited with her daughter.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的母亲芭芭拉在基督教信仰中寻求慰藉，她坚信自己有一天会与女儿团聚。

sentences.en: Jennifer's mother, Patty, likewise found comfort in religion and began coordinating a child safety fair that was held in Tacoma every year.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗的母亲帕蒂同样在宗教中找到安慰，并开始筹办每年在塔科马举行一次的儿童安全博览会。

sentences.en: In an interview with the News Tribune, she stated,
sentences.zh: 在接受《新闻论坛报》采访时，她表示，

sentences.en: "...I can always calm myself down with the knowledge that whether we as human beings solve the crime or not, it is solved.
sentences.zh: “……我总是可以用这样的认知来安慰自己：无论我们人类最终能否破案，正义终究得到了伸张。

sentences.en: And whether justice happens in the criminal courts or the heavenly courts, it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 无论正义是在刑事法庭上实现，还是在天堂的法庭上实现，这都无关紧要。

sentences.en: It will happen." In the summer of 1986, 11-year-old Lindsay
sentences.zh: 它一定会发生。”在1986年夏天，11岁的琳赛·

sentences.en: Wade had her innocence shattered by the murders of Michelle Welch and Jennifer Bastion.
sentences.zh: 韦德因米歇尔·韦尔奇和珍妮弗·巴斯蒂安的谋杀案而失去了童年的纯真。

sentences.en: Prior to learning about the two crimes, she'd been a carefree child, growing up in Tacoma oblivious to the
sentences.zh: 在得知这两起罪行之前，她一直是个无忧无虑的孩子，在塔科马长大，对

sentences.en: dangers that might exiSt. After she found out what had happened to Michelle and Jennifer, Lindsay became scared, like much of the broader community.
sentences.zh: 可能存在的危险懵然不知。在得知米歇尔和珍妮弗的遭遇后，琳赛和广大社区的大多数人一样感到了害怕。

sentences.en: The two girls were close to her in age and had been killed while out riding their bikes in local parks, something Lindsay also loved to do.
sentences.zh: 这两个女孩与她年龄相仿，却在当地公园骑自行车时被杀害，而这也是琳赛非常喜欢做的事情。

sentences.en: All over Tacoma, everyone was asking how such a thing could have happened and who was responsible.
sentences.zh: 整个塔科马的人们都在质问，怎么会发生这种事，究竟是谁干的。

sentences.en: Alarmist headlines and news stories added to Lindsay's fear and she no longer felt safe playing in the woods as she had before.
sentences.zh: 耸人听闻的头条新闻和新闻报道加剧了琳赛的恐惧，她再也无法像以前那样觉得在树林里玩耍是安全的。

sentences.en: This newfound fear persisted over the following years.
sentences.zh: 这种新产生的恐惧在接下来的几年里一直挥之不去。

sentences.en: As a junior high student, Lindsay sometimes had to walk past a wooded gulch on her way to school and doing so always made her heart race.
sentences.zh: 作为一名初中生，琳赛上学路上有时不得不走过一个树木丛生的峡谷，每次走过都让她心跳加速。

sentences.en: She couldn't help imagining a dangerous predator lurking nearby, waiting to snatch her.
sentences.zh: 她忍不住想象一个危险的掠食者正潜伏在附近，等待着将她劫持。

sentences.en: Looking back as an adult, it would later seem to Lindsay as though her entire childhood and adolescence was coloured by the two unsolved murders that devastated Tacoma in 1986.
sentences.zh: 成年后回首往事，琳赛觉得她整个童年和青春期似乎都被1986年震惊塔科马的两起未破谋杀案涂上了阴影。

sentences.en: During high school, Lindsay developed an interest in criminal investigations after reading author
sentences.zh: 高中期间，在读了作家

sentences.en: Ian Rule's book about serial killer Ted Bundy who was also from Tacoma.
sentences.zh: 伊恩·鲁尔关于同样来自塔科马的连环杀手特德·邦迪的书后，琳赛对刑事调查产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: After graduating, Lindsay ultimately decided that she wanted to become a police officer and then a detective.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，琳赛最终决定成为一名警察，然后成为一名侦探。

sentences.en: She achieved both ambitions by 2003 when she was promoted to the role of detective at the Tacoma Police Department.
sentences.zh: 她在2003年实现了这两个目标，当时她被晋升为塔科马警察局的侦探。

sentences.en: The now-detective Lindsay Wade spent time investigating auto thefts and was then assigned to the sex crimes department.
sentences.zh: 现任侦探的琳赛·韦德曾花时间调查汽车盗窃案，随后被调往性犯罪部门。

sentences.en: In 2008, she was transferred to the homicide squad.
sentences.zh: 2008年，她被调到凶杀组。

sentences.en: In 2009, Detective Wade had her first child and took five months off for maternity leave.
sentences.zh: 2009年，韦德侦探有了她的第一个孩子，并请了五个月的产假。

sentences.en: That same year, Tacoma Police Department established a cold case unit, which would be dedicated to investigating old, unsolved cases.
sentences.zh: 同年，塔科马警察局成立了一个未决案件（冷案）调查组，专门负责调查陈年未破的案件。

sentences.en: They had more than 250 unsolved homicides and missing persons cases on their books,
sentences.zh: 他们的档案里有250多起未破的凶杀案和失踪人口案，

sentences.en: but the inspiration for the unit's formation was the 1986 murders of Michelle Welch and Jennifer Bastian.
sentences.zh: 但该部门成立的灵感来源是1986年米歇尔·韦尔奇和珍妮弗·巴斯蒂安的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Twenty-three years had passed since the two young girls were murdered, and both cases still remained unsolved due in part to the police department not having the resources to
sentences.zh: 距离这两名年轻女孩被谋杀已经过去了二十三年，两起案件至今仍未侦破，部分原因在于警察局没有足够的资源

sentences.en: dedicate to older cases.
sentences.zh: 投入到陈年旧案中。

sentences.en: With a dedicated unit, detectives could finally take a closer look at the case files.
sentences.zh: 有了专门的调查组，侦探们终于可以重新仔细审阅案卷了。

sentences.en: When Detective Lindsay Wade returned from maternity leave, she began reviewing a number of the cold cases alongside the head of the unit, Detective Gene Miller.
sentences.zh: 当琳赛·韦德侦探产假归来时，她开始与该部门负责人吉恩·米勒侦探一起审查多起冷案。

sentences.en: One of the cases Detective Wade began pouring over was that of Jennifer Bastian and Michelle Welch.
sentences.zh: 韦德侦探开始仔细研读的案件之一就是珍妮弗·巴斯蒂安和米歇尔·韦尔奇案。

sentences.en: The crimes that had haunted her since she was a little girl were even more disturbing up close and with access to all of the details.
sentences.zh: 这些自她小时候起就一直困扰着她的罪行，在近距离接触并掌握了所有细节后，显得更加令人不安。

sentences.en: Over the next few years, Detective Wade returned to the case whenever she had the time.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，韦德侦探只要有空就会重新调查这个案件。

sentences.en: Motivated by the memory of the fear she had felt as a child and the desire to help get justice for the girls, she painstakingly combed through the case file.
sentences.zh: 出于对童年时期感受到的恐惧的记忆，以及为女孩们伸张正义的渴望，她一丝不苟地梳理了案卷。

sentences.en: In 2013, Detective Wade met Jennifer Bastian's parents for the first time during a visit to their home with Detective Miller.
sentences.zh: 2013年，韦德侦探与米勒侦探一同造访詹妮弗·巴斯蒂安的家，这是她首次与詹妮弗的父母见面。

sentences.en: As the two investigators were leaving,
sentences.zh: 正当两名调查人员准备离开时，

sentences.en: Jennifer's father Ralph begged them to solve the case, adding that he didn't have much time left.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗的父亲拉尔夫恳求他们破案，并补充说他已经时日不多了。

sentences.en: He had been 59 when his daughter was murdered and was now 86 years old.
sentences.zh: 女儿遇害时他59岁，而现在他已经86岁高龄了。

sentences.en: He desperately wanted to see justice for Jennifer before he died.
sentences.zh: 他极其渴望在自己离世前看到詹妮弗沉冤得雪。

sentences.en: Seeking additional expert opinions, the detectives took the case to the
sentences.zh: 为了寻求更多专家的意见，侦探们将此案带到了

sentences.en: National Center for Missing and Exploited Children in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 位于弗吉尼亚州的国家失踪与被剥削儿童中心。

sentences.en: There, they spoke about the case with a panel of 20 experts including current and former FBI agents, consultants specialising in crimes against
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们与一个由20名专家组成的专家组讨论了该案，其中包括现任和前任联邦调查局特工、专门研究儿童

sentences.en: children and two forensic scientists.
sentences.zh: 犯罪的顾问以及两名法医科学家。

sentences.en: This trip helped galvanise the two detectives and they came up with some new ideas as to where they could take the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这次行程极大地鼓舞了两位侦探，他们针对调查的下一步方向提出了一些新想法。

sentences.en: Subsequently, Detective Miller submitted
sentences.zh: 随后，米勒侦探将

sentences.en: Jennifer Bastian's swimsuit away for testing.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·巴斯蒂安的泳衣送去检测。

sentences.en: The swimsuit had been worn by Jennifer on the day of her murder and was found around her ankle at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 这件泳衣是詹妮弗遇害当天穿的，被发现时缠在犯罪现场她的脚踝周围。

sentences.en: Over the ensuing two and a half decades, it was preserved in evidence.
sentences.zh: 在随后的二十五年半里，它一直作为物证保存着。

sentences.en: DNA testing had advanced in leaps and bounds since then, and the detectives hoped that forensic scientists might be able to obtain a DNA profile for Jennifer from the swimsuit.
sentences.zh: 自那时起，DNA检测技术突飞猛进，侦探们希望法医科学家能够从泳衣中提取出詹妮弗的DNA图谱。

sentences.en: This profile would then be used as a reference sample.
sentences.zh: 这个图谱随后将用作参考样本。

sentences.en: In November 2013, the detectives received a phone call from a scientist at the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 2013年11月，侦探们接到了实验室科学家的电话。

sentences.en: He asked whether they were also interested in a profile for the male DNA found in Jennifer's swimsuit.
sentences.zh: 他询问他们是否也对在詹妮弗泳衣上发现的男性DNA图谱感兴趣。

sentences.en: He explained that recovered in the crotch of the swimsuit was a semen sample which had been tested and was found to belong to one man.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，在泳衣的裆部提取到了一个精液样本，经检测属于一名男子。

sentences.en: The detectives were shocked.
sentences.zh: 侦探们大为震惊。

sentences.en: This evidence had been completely missed by the case's original investigators.
sentences.zh: 这一证据完全被该案最初的调查人员忽略了。

sentences.en: Perhaps because the swimsuit had been removed from Jennifer's body, they had assumed the perpetrator's DNA wouldn't be on it.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为泳衣是从詹妮弗身上脱下来的，他们曾认为凶手的DNA不会留在上面。

sentences.en: There was another shock to follow.
sentences.zh: 接下来还有另一个震惊发现。

sentences.en: Since the early 1990s, investigators had had a DNA profile for the killer of Michelle Welch and Jennifer
sentences.zh: 自20世纪90年初以来，调查人员就掌握了米歇尔·韦尔奇和詹妮弗

sentences.en: Bastian.
sentences.zh: ·巴斯蒂安凶手的DNA图谱。

sentences.en: This had been built from semen recovered from Michelle Welch's remains.
sentences.zh: 这是从米歇尔·韦尔奇遗体中提取的精液构建出来的。

sentences.en: When the new sample from Jennifer's swimsuit was compared to that taken from Michelle's crime scene, investigators were stunned to find that it wasn't a match.
sentences.zh: 当把来自詹妮弗泳衣的新样本与从米歇尔犯罪现场提取的样本进行对比时，调查人员震惊地发现两者并不匹配。

sentences.en: They weren't looking for one killer, they were looking for two.
sentences.zh: 他们寻找的不是一个凶手，而是两个。

sentences.en: This revelation totally upended the investigation.
sentences.zh: 这一重大发现彻底颠覆了调查方向。

sentences.en: Almost from the start, detectives had believed the cases must have been connected.
sentences.zh: 几乎从一开始，侦探们就坚信这两个案件必然有关联。

sentences.en: Stranger abductions, assaults and murders were rare and Tacoma was seen as a safe, upper-middle-class city.
sentences.zh: 陌生人绑架、袭击和谋杀事件极为罕见，而塔科马曾被视为一个安全的中上阶层城市。

sentences.en: The similarities between the two crimes were overwhelming, right down to the victim profiles, the manner of the attacks and the locations they had taken place in.
sentences.zh: 两起犯罪之间的相似之处惊人地一致，甚至连受害者特征、袭击手法以及案发地点都如出一辙。

sentences.en: What were the odds that the two girls had been killed by two different men within just four months of each other?
sentences.zh: 两个女孩在短短四个月内被两个不同的男人杀害，这种概率有多大？

sentences.en: Yet, now the DNA made clear that two separate individuals bore responsibility.
sentences.zh: 然而，如今DNA清楚地表明，这是由两个不同的人分别犯下的罪行。

sentences.en: Perhaps Jennifer's murder had been a copycat crime with Michelle's providing the inspiration, but that was as far as the connection went.
sentences.zh: 也许詹妮弗的谋杀案是一起以米歇尔案为灵感的模仿作案，但也仅此而已，两案并无其他交集。

sentences.en: Over the past decade, investigators had run the DNA from Michelle's case through the Combined DNA Index System, or CODIS, the United States National Police DNA database.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年里，调查人员已将米歇尔案中的DNA输入了美国国家警察DNA数据库——综合DNA索引系统（简称CODIS）。

sentences.en: They'd never found a match.
sentences.zh: 但他们从未找到匹配项。

sentences.en: Now, they checked the profile from Jennifer's killer,
sentences.zh: 现在，他们核查了詹妮弗凶手的DNA图谱，

sentences.en: It wasn't a match to anyone in the CODIS system either.
sentences.zh: 结果发现它与CODIS系统中的任何人也都不匹配。

sentences.en: That meant neither killer had a criminal record.
sentences.zh: 这意味着两个凶手都没有犯罪前科。

sentences.en: Detectives had also used the DNA from Michelle's case to eliminate more than 100 possible suspects from both cases.
sentences.zh: 侦探们还利用米歇尔案中的DNA排除了两起案件中100多名可能的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Now, it was possible that those individuals could still be suspects in Jennifer's murder.
sentences.zh: 而现在，这些人仍然有可能是詹妮弗谋杀案的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Similarly, other persons of interest had been ruled out because they'd been incarcerated or had alibis for one of the murders.
sentences.zh: 同样，其他一些备受关注人员此前因为被监禁或在其中一起谋杀案发生时拥有不在场证明而被排除。

sentences.en: The fact investigators were now looking for two killers would mean those individuals would need to be looked at again.
sentences.zh: 鉴于调查人员现在正在寻找两名凶手，这意味着这些人都需要重新接受调查。

sentences.en: Detective Gene Miller began compiling a list of suspects who hadn't been eliminated via DNA.
sentences.zh: 吉恩·米勒侦探开始着手整理一份未被DNA排除的嫌疑人名单。

sentences.en: The goal was now to obtain voluntary samples from them so they could be checked against the evidence.
sentences.zh: 当时的目标是从他们身上获取自愿捐献的样本，以便与物证进行比对。

sentences.en: Roughly two dozen individuals willingly provided their
sentences.zh: 大约两打人自愿提供了他们的

sentences.en: DNA to detectives and were gradually ruled out as suspects.
sentences.zh: DNA给侦探，并逐渐被排除嫌疑。

sentences.en: Detective Lindsay Wade trawled through the police department's old records searching for any cases with similarities to Jennifer Bastion's.
sentences.zh: 琳赛·韦德侦探翻阅了警察局的旧档案，寻找任何与詹妮弗·巴斯蒂安案有相似之处的案件。

sentences.en: Any time she came across the name of a suspect or person of interest, she would look them up and run a background check.
sentences.zh: 每当她看到某个嫌疑人或重点关注人员的名字时，她就会去查阅并进行背景调查。

sentences.en: When they couldn't be eliminated through DNA in CODIS, she would often add them to the list for voluntary sample collection.
sentences.zh: 当这些人无法通过CODIS中的DNA被排除时，她通常会将他们加入自愿采样名单中。

sentences.en: This work was slow.
sentences.zh: 这项工作进展缓慢。

sentences.en: In January of 2015, Detective Miller retired and Detective
sentences.zh: 2015年1月，米勒侦探退休，韦德侦探

sentences.en: Wade replaced him as the lead investigator.
sentences.zh: 接替他成为首席调查员。

sentences.en: Months later, Detective Wade utilised the innovative technique of phenotyping to gain a clearer picture of her suspects.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，韦德侦探运用了创新的表型分析技术，以便更清晰地刻画嫌疑人的外貌特征。

sentences.en: Phenotyping involves identifying a person's physical characteristics based on the DNA.
sentences.zh: 表型分析是指根据DNA确定一个人的身体特征。

sentences.en: The results indicated that Jennifer's murderer was white with light eyes and blonde or red hair.
sentences.zh: 结果显示，詹妮弗的凶手是白人，浅色眼睛，金发或红发。

sentences.en: Michelle's killer was predominantly of European heritage but had 9% Native American ancestry.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的凶手主要具有欧洲血统，但也拥有9%的美洲原住民血统。

sentences.en: He had fair skin, a round face, brown or hazel eyes, and brown hair.
sentences.zh: 他皮肤白皙，圆脸，棕色或榛色眼睛，棕色头发。

sentences.en: Composite sketches of both men were created and shared with the public.
sentences.zh: 警方制作了两名男子的合成画像并向公众发布。

sentences.en: That same year,
sentences.zh: 同年，

sentences.en: Detective Wade learnt of a cutting edge technique that might help in the case.
sentences.zh: 韦德侦探了解到一项可能对该案有帮助的前沿技术。

sentences.en: Investigators were now using Y chromosome DNA to hone in on potential suspects.
sentences.zh: 调查人员现在正利用Y染色体DNA来缩小潜在嫌疑人的范围。

sentences.en: As Y chromosome DNA is passed down from father to son.
sentences.zh: 因为Y染色体DNA是从父亲传给儿子的。

sentences.en: Men who shared the same YSTR DNA profile typically have the same surname.
sentences.zh: 拥有相同YSTR DNA图谱的男性通常拥有相同的姓氏。

sentences.en: The exceptions are when a son has been given his mother's last name, is adopted, or is unaware of his true biological father's identity.
sentences.zh: 例外情况是儿子随了母亲的姓、被收养，或者不知道其亲生父亲的真实身份。

sentences.en: Some genealogists involved in forensic investigations were now using
sentences.zh: 一些参与法医调查的基因学家现在开始利用

sentences.en: YSTR DNA profiles to come up with possible surnames for male suspects.
sentences.zh: YSTR DNA图谱来推测男性嫌疑人的可能姓氏。

sentences.en: Detective Wade wasn't sure about this new technique but figured it was worth a shot.
sentences.zh: 韦德侦探对这项新技术并不太确定，但觉得值得一试。

sentences.en: She reached out to Dr Colleen Fitzpatrick, a genealogist who had founded a forensic genealogy organisation called Identifiers International.
sentences.zh: 她联系了科琳·菲茨帕特里克博士，这是一位创立了名为“国际识别者”法医基因alogy组织的基因学家。

sentences.en: The detective sent the profile of Jennifer's killer to Dr Fitzpatrick, asking for any possible surnames that might be associated with it.
sentences.zh: 女侦探将詹妮弗凶手的图谱发送给菲茨帕特里克博士，询问可能与之相关的任何姓氏。

sentences.en: Three names were sent back – Smith,
sentences.zh: 对方传回了三个名字——史密斯（Smith）、

sentences.en: Holbrook and Washburn.
sentences.zh: 霍尔布鲁克（Holbrook）和沃什本（Washburn）。

sentences.en: Wondering if anyone with those names might be mentioned in the case file,
sentences.zh: 韦德侦探琢磨着案卷中是否会提到拥有这些名字的人，

sentences.en: Detective Wade scoured it for the name Holbrook, but found nothing.
sentences.zh: 于是她在案卷中搜寻“霍尔布鲁克”这个名字，但一无所获。

sentences.en: Given how common Smith was as a surname, the detective didn't think she'd have any luck there.
sentences.zh: 鉴于史密斯是一个极其普通的姓氏，侦探认为在那上面不会有什么运气。

sentences.en: She turned her attention to the final name on the list – Washburn.
sentences.zh: 她将注意力转向了名单上的最后一个名字——沃什本。

sentences.en: One result came back.
sentences.zh: 查到一个结果。

sentences.en: In May 1986, several months before Jennifer was murdered, a man named Robert Washburn called the police with a tip-off for the Michelle Welch case.
sentences.zh: 1986年5月，即詹妮弗遇害几个月前，一名叫罗伯特·沃什本的男子打电话给警方，为米歇尔·韦尔奇案提供了一条线索。

sentences.en: He said that he'd seen the suspect sketch of
sentences.zh: 他说他看到了米歇尔

sentences.en: Michelle's killer and realised that he'd recognised it.
sentences.zh: 凶手的嫌疑人画像，并意识到自己认出了这个人。

sentences.en: Washburn said he'd been out jogging when he saw a man who resembled the sketch loitering in a park.
sentences.zh: 沃什本说他当时正在慢跑，看到一个长相与画像相似的男子在一个公园里闲逛。

sentences.en: But he hadn't seen the man in Puget Park where
sentences.zh: 但他看到那个男人的地方并不是米歇尔被杀的

sentences.en: Michelle was killed.
sentences.zh: 普吉特公园（Puget Park）。

sentences.en: He said the man had been at Point Defiance Park, the location where Jennifer would be attacked and killed three months later.
sentences.zh: 他说那个男人在点防御公园（Point Defiance Park），也就是三个月后詹妮弗遭到袭击并遇害的地点。

sentences.en: In December of that year, detectives had paid Robert Washburn a visit at home to follow up on his tip-off.
sentences.zh: 当年12月，侦探们曾造访罗伯特·沃什本的家以跟进他的这条线索。

sentences.en: He'd repeated his story about seeing a man who resembled the sketch in Point Defiance Park, lurking near the Rhododendron Garden.
sentences.zh: 他重复了之前的说法，称看到一个长相酷似画像的男子在点防御公园里，徘徊在杜鹃花园附近。

sentences.en: Washburn explained that he jogged in the park up to twice a day, always along the trails off Five Mile Drive.
sentences.zh: 沃什本解释说，他每天在公园慢跑多达两次，路线总是沿着五英里大道（Five Mile Drive）旁的小径。

sentences.en: He had lost his job, so had plenty of time to do so.
sentences.zh: 他失业了，所以有充足的时间这样做。

sentences.en: He'd added that he'd been in the park after Jennifer Bastian went missing and saw police searching.
sentences.zh: 他还补充说，在詹妮弗·巴斯蒂安失踪后他也去过公园，并看到警察在搜寻。

sentences.en: He'd also noticed a foul smell emanating from Five Mile Drive in the subsequent weeks but hadn't known what it was.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几周里，他还注意到五英里大道散发出恶臭，但当时不知道是什么气味。

sentences.en: The 1986 detectives had found nothing suspicious in
sentences.zh: 1986年的侦探们在

sentences.en: Robert Washburn's conduct or demeanour.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·沃什本的行为或神态中没有发现任何可疑之处。

sentences.en: They noted his name in the case file and left it at that.
sentences.zh: 他们在案卷中记下了他的名字，事情就此搁置。

sentences.en: Detective Lindsay Wade was somewhat dubious about the YSTR surname selection, but she added Robert
sentences.zh: 琳赛·韦德侦探对YSTR姓氏筛选法有些半信半疑，但她还是将罗伯特

sentences.en: Washburn to her list of persons of interest to be approached for a voluntary DNA sample.
sentences.zh: ·沃什本列入了需要接触以获取自愿DNA样本的重点关注人员名单中。

sentences.en: She'd been painstakingly creating a record of every male mentioned in Jennifer's case file, along with whether or not their DNA was on file.
sentences.zh: 她一直在煞费苦心地建立詹妮弗案卷中提及的所有男性的记录，并标注了他们的DNA是否已在案存档。

sentences.en: There were more than 2,300 names on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 名单上有2300多个名字。

sentences.en: It was ordered from most to least suspicious and individuals were only eliminated from the list if
sentences.zh: 这些名字按可疑程度从高到低排序，只有当个人的

sentences.en: their DNA failed to match or if they'd been incarcerated at the time of the murder.
sentences.zh: DNA比对不匹配或者他们在谋杀发生时被关押在监狱中，才会被从名单中排除。

sentences.en: Detective Wade was assisted by a special agent from the FBI and together they were able to track down and obtain DNA samples from a number of suspects.
sentences.zh: 韦德侦探得到了联邦调查局一名特别特工的协助，他们共同追踪并获取了多名嫌疑人的DNA样本。

sentences.en: After a few months, Detective Wade's department had chased down 121 suspect samples from Washington to be tested.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，韦德侦探的部门已经从华盛顿州追查了121份嫌疑人样本进行检测。

sentences.en: The FBI focused on interstate persons of interest tracking down an additional 40 samples.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局则重点关注跨州的重点关注人员，追踪并获取了另外40份样本。

sentences.en: Testing all of these took a long time.
sentences.zh: 检测所有这些样本花费了很长时间。

sentences.en: During 2017, Detective Wade submitted more than 100 to be tested.
sentences.zh: 2017年期间，韦德侦探送检了100多份样本。

sentences.en: None were a match.
sentences.zh: 没有一个匹配的。

sentences.en: A second batch was also submitted with no positive results.
sentences.zh: 第二批送检的样本同样没有得出阳性结果。

sentences.en: In January 2018, Detective Wade sent a final batch of 18 samples away for testing.
sentences.zh: 2018年1月，韦德侦探寄出了最后一批18个样本进行检测。

sentences.en: Given so many promising suspects had already been ruled out after having their DNA tested, her hopes were low.
sentences.zh: 鉴于那么多有希望的嫌疑人在测试DNA后已经被排除，她对此并不抱太大希望。

sentences.en: Several months later, in April, Detective Wade retired from the Tacoma Police
sentences.zh: 几个月后的4月，韦德侦探从塔科马警察

sentences.en: Department.
sentences.zh: 局退休了。

sentences.en: She'd been there for 14 years and the job had left her burnt out.
sentences.zh: 她在那里工作了14年，这份工作让她精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Less than one month after her last day, Lindsay Wade was at home when she received a phone call from the detective who had taken over her role.
sentences.zh: 在她退休后的一个月内，琳赛·韦德正在家中，突然接到了接替她职务的侦探打来的电话。

sentences.en: After she answered, he immediately asked if she was sitting down, then stated,
sentences.zh: 她接听后，对方立刻问她有没有坐下，然后说道：

sentences.en: there's a match on Jennifer Bastion.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗·巴斯蒂安案有匹配结果了。

sentences.en: In shock and unable to speak, it took Lindsay a minute before she asked for the man's name.
sentences.zh: 琳赛震惊得说不出话来，过了一分钟她才问出那个男人的名字。

sentences.en: Robert Washburn, the detective replied.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·沃什本，侦探回答道。

sentences.en: In 1986, Robert Washburn was 28 years old.
sentences.zh: 1986年时，罗伯特·沃什本28岁。

sentences.en: He lived about two miles from Point Defiance Park and was divorced.
sentences.zh: 他住在离点防御公园大约两英里远的地方，当时已经离婚。

sentences.en: He and his wife had split the year before, after six years of marriage.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子在结婚六年后的前一年分居了。

sentences.en: 1985 hadn't been great for Washburn overall, as he was also arrested that year on suspicion of vehicle prowling and criminal trespass.
sentences.zh: 对沃什本来说，1985年总体算不上好年景，因为他那一年还因涉嫌窥探车辆和非法侵入罪被捕。

sentences.en: However, he ultimately wasn't charged and consequently had no criminal record.
sentences.zh: 然而，他最终没有被起诉，因此没有犯罪前科。

sentences.en: The next time he'd come to police attention was in May 1986, when he'd reported seeing the suspect in the Michelle Welch case hanging around at Point Defiance Park.
sentences.zh: 他下一次引起警方注意是在1986年5月，当时他报告说看到米歇尔·韦尔奇案的嫌疑人在点防御公园闲逛。

sentences.en: Given the timing of this call and the fact it took place before Jennifer Bastion's murder, investigators would later wonder if
sentences.zh: 鉴于这通电话的时间以及它发生在詹妮弗·巴斯蒂安遇害之前的事实，调查人员后来不禁怀疑

sentences.en: Washburn was already scheming to kill a girl and frame the other murderer for it.
sentences.zh: 沃什本当时是否已经在策划杀害一个女孩并将罪名嫁祸给另一个凶手。

sentences.en: Another theory was that he'd become fixated by the Michelle Welch case and got a thrill out of inserting himself into the investigation.
sentences.zh: 另一种理论是，他对米歇尔·韦尔奇案产生了偏执的迷恋，并从让自己卷入调查中获得了一种刺激感。

sentences.en: Maybe his fixation had grown to the point where he'd decided to commit a copycat crime.
sentences.zh: 也许他的这种执念不断加剧，以至于他决定实施一起模仿作案。

sentences.en: In the years that followed, Washburn began working for an airplane and aerospace company as a mechanic.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，沃什本开始在一家飞机和航空航天公司担任机械师。

sentences.en: He remarried in 1990 and he and his second wife had a daughter.
sentences.zh: 他在1990年再婚，他和第二任妻子育有一个女儿。

sentences.en: During the late 1990s they relocated to the Washington city of Burlington.
sentences.zh: 20世纪90年代末，他们搬到了华盛顿州的伯灵顿市。

sentences.en: Robert Washburn filed for bankruptcy in 2000 and about a decade later he relocated to the state of Illinois.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·沃什本于2000年申请破产，大约十年后他又搬到了伊利诺伊州。

sentences.en: He was found there by the FBI in March 2017, after Detective
sentences.zh: 2017年3月，联邦调查局在那里找到了他，此前侦探

sentences.en: Lindsay Wade added his name to her suspect liSt. By then, Washburn was 60 years old and living in the city of Eureka with his now 25-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 琳赛·韦德将他的名字加入了她的嫌疑人名单。当时，沃什本已经60岁，和现年25岁的女儿住在尤里卡市。

sentences.en: She had cerebral palsy and required a feeding tube, and Washburn was her full-time caregiver.
sentences.zh: 她患有脑瘫，需要依靠鼻饲管进食，而沃什本是她的全职照顾者。

sentences.en: When the FBI asked Washburn for a DNA sample, he obliged.
sentences.zh: 当联邦调查局要求沃什本提供DNA样本时，他欣然配合。

sentences.en: It would take more than a year for the results to come back, yet Washburn made no attempt to relocate or flee during that time.
sentences.zh: 检测结果历时一年多才出来，然而在此期间，沃什本没有试图搬迁或逃跑。

sentences.en: When FBI agents returned to his home to arrest him in May 2018, he went willingly and didn't fight extradition to Washington.
sentences.zh: 2018年5月，当联邦调查局特工重返他家将他逮捕时，他十分配合，并没有抗拒引渡回华盛顿州。

sentences.en: His cooperation only went so far, though, as he refused to speak with detectives.
sentences.zh: 不过他的配合也就到此为止了，因为他拒绝与侦探交谈。

sentences.en: When told that his DNA matched that of a murder suspect, he stated, I did not kill that little girl.
sentences.zh: 当被告知他的DNA与一名谋杀案嫌疑人相匹配时，他声称：我没有杀那个小女孩。

sentences.en: Up until that point, detectives hadn't disclosed that the case was related to a young girl.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，侦探们并未透露该案与一个小女孩有关。

sentences.en: Washburn explained the presence of his DNA as being due to his frequent visits to Point Defiance Park, saying, My DNA was all over that park.
sentences.zh: 沃什本解释说，他的DNA之所以存在，是因为他经常光顾点防御公园，他说：我的DNA遍布那个公园。

sentences.en: Robert Washburn was returned to Tacoma and arraigned in court after being charged with Jennifer's murder.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·沃什本被押回塔科马，在被指控谋杀詹妮弗后出庭受审。

sentences.en: Many of those who knew him were shocked.
sentences.zh: 许多认识他的人都感到震惊。

sentences.en: Neighbours described him as a kind but quiet man who kept to himself and was devoted to his daughter.
sentences.zh: 邻居们形容他是一个善良但安静、独善其身且对女儿十分孝顺的男人。

sentences.en: Disturbingly, though, he was known to be very friendly with a 12-year-old girl who lived in his apartment building.

sentences.en: One of the detectives approached a McDonald's employee who was cleaning the area and explained who he was.
sentences.zh: 其中一名侦探走到正在清理该区域的一名麦当劳员工身旁，表明了自己的身份。

sentences.en: He asked if she would collect Hartman's bag from him under the guise of doing her job so they could take it into evidence.
sentences.zh: 他请对方借着工作的名义把哈特曼的袋子收走，以便他们将其作为物证带走。

sentences.en: The employee agreed and went up to Hartman asking if she could remove his rubbish for him.
sentences.zh: 这名员工同意了，她走到哈特曼跟前询问是否可以帮他清理垃圾。

sentences.en: He agreed, waving at the bag to indicate she should take it.
sentences.zh: 他答应了，并对着袋子挥了挥手示意她拿走。

sentences.en: The employee collected it and it was subtly handed over to the detectives.
sentences.zh: 员工收下了袋子，并悄悄将其交给了侦探。

sentences.en: The napkin was processed for a DNA analysis.
sentences.zh: 技术人员对这份纸巾进行了DNA分析。

sentences.en: The profile obtained from it was a perfect match to the DNA recovered from 12-year-old Michelle Welch's body.
sentences.zh: 从上面提取出的DNA图谱与12岁女孩米歇尔·韦尔奇遗体上提取的DNA完全吻合。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, at 5.30am on Wednesday June 20, police officers arrived at Hartman's home and waited quietly for him to leave.
sentences.zh: 两周后的6月20日星期三清晨5点30分，警官们抵达哈特曼的住所外，静静等待他出门。

sentences.en: He emerged five hours later at 10.30 and drove away in an SUV.
sentences.zh: 五个小时后，即10点30分，他现身并驾驶一辆SUV离开。

sentences.en: He was followed by his adult daughter in another car.
sentences.zh: 他的成年女儿开着另一辆车跟在后面。

sentences.en: Officers pursued the father and daughter and when Hartman braked at a stop sign, they pulled in alongside and in front of him.
sentences.zh: 警官们追赶着这对父女，当哈特曼在停车标志前刹车时，警官们将车开到他的侧面和前方将其截停。

sentences.en: A detective approached Hartman's window which
sentences.zh: 一名侦探走近哈特曼的车窗，

sentences.en: Hartman rolled down.
sentences.zh: 哈特曼摇下了车窗。

sentences.en: You're under arrest, turn off the car and step out, the detective said.
sentences.zh: “你被捕了，熄火下车，”侦探说道。

sentences.en: Hartman did as he was told, asking why he was being arrested as he was handcuffed.
sentences.zh: 哈特曼照做了，在被戴上手铐时询问自己为什么被捕。

sentences.en: He was informed that he would be told the reason later.
sentences.zh: 他被告知稍后会有人告诉他原因。

sentences.zh: 随后，哈特曼被指控强奸并谋杀米歇尔·

sentences.en: This was no easy task as the house was in poor condition.

sentences.zh: 他们原本希望找到米歇尔的粉红色眼镜，但这副眼镜并未与她的遗体一起被发现。

sentences.zh: 加里·哈特曼否认杀害了米歇尔·韦尔奇，并在被告知他面临的指控时表示要找律师谈谈。

sentences.en: Buccal swabs taken by detectives confirmed that he was a match to the killer.
sentences.zh: 侦探提取的口腔拭子证实他与凶手吻合。

sentences.en: Prior to becoming a mental health technician in 1992, Gary Hartman had been in the Navy and then had a series of menial jobs.
sentences.zh: 在1992年成为一名精神健康技术员之前，加里·哈特曼曾在海军服役，随后做过一系列杂务工作。

sentences.en: He seemed to find his niche in mental health care, later getting a job as a registered nurse in 1998.
sentences.zh: 他似乎在心理健康护理领域找到了自己的用武之地，后来在1998年成为了一名注册护士。

sentences.en: He had been married four different times to three different women.
sentences.zh: 他曾与三个不同的女人有过四段婚姻。

sentences.en: He was divorced twice and married to his second wife at the time of Michelle's murder.
sentences.zh: 他离婚两次，在米歇尔遇害时正与他的第二任妻子维持婚姻。

sentences.en: Hartman's marriages with his first two wives broke down due to his infidelity.
sentences.zh: 哈特曼与前两任妻子的婚姻都因他的不忠而破裂。

sentences.en: He wed his third wife in 1996 and they were still together at the time of his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 他在1996年迎娶了第三任妻子，在被捕时两人依然在一起。

sentences.en: The couple had two adopted daughters.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇收养了两个女儿。

sentences.en: Hartman's family said he was a functioning alcoholic, but his attorney claimed he had found sobriety in 1989 at the age of 38.
sentences.zh: 哈特曼的家人说他是一个功能性酒精依赖者，但他的律师声称他在1989年（38岁时）已经戒酒。

sentences.zh: RJ·哈特曼告诉警方，在他还是个孩子的时候，哥哥经常虐待他，用

sentences.en: RJ also accused his brother of raping him and said he'd tortured and killed animals.
sentences.zh: RJ还指控他的哥哥强奸了他，并称他曾虐待和杀死动物。

sentences.en: According to RJ, Hartman loathed women, a result of his hatred for his mother.
sentences.zh: 据RJ称，哈特曼痛恨女性，这是他对母亲的恨意导致的。

sentences.en: She suffered from alcoholism and was an abusive parent.
sentences.zh: 她患有酒精依赖，是一个施虐的家长。

sentences.en: RJ claimed that when his mother had female friends over and they passed out from drinking, Hartman would rape them.
sentences.zh: RJ称，当母亲邀请女性朋友来家里做客且她们因饮酒不省人事时，哈特曼就会强奸她们。

sentences.en: RJ said that Hartman had long been fascinated by little girls.
sentences.zh: RJ说，哈特曼长期以来一直对小女孩有着迷恋。

sentences.en: He'd made inappropriate remarks about RJ's daughter when she was eight years old.
sentences.zh: RJ的女儿八岁时，曾遭到他发表的不当言论调侃。

sentences.en: It would turn out that one year after Michelle's murder, Gary Hartman was arrested for public indecency after he exposed himself to a young girl at a store.
sentences.zh: 结果显示，在米歇尔遇害一年后，加里·哈特曼因在一家商店向一名年轻女孩裸露身体而因寻衅滋事罪被捕。

sentences.en: He was arrested for this crime but for some reason was never convicted and had no criminal record.
sentences.zh: 他因这起犯罪被捕，但出于某种原因从未被定罪，也没有犯罪记录。

sentences.en: However, he was ordered to see a psychiatriSt. In a disturbing twist of fate, it would turn out that RJ's daughter had been school friends with Jennifer Bastian.
sentences.zh: 不过，他被责令接受精神科医生治疗。在命运令人不安的巧合下，RJ的女儿后来和詹妮弗·巴斯蒂安成了学校里的朋友。

sentences.en: Gary Hartman had been fascinated by Jennifer's case and frequently spoke of it to his family.
sentences.zh: 加里·哈特曼一直对詹妮弗的案子很着迷，并经常向家人提起此事。

sentences.en: He claimed he was friends with a detective working on the case and so he knew things about it that others didn't.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己认识一名负责该案的侦探，因此知道一些别人不知道的内情。

sentences.en: He never spoke of Michelle Welch's murder.
sentences.zh: 他从未提及米歇尔·韦尔奇遇害的事。

sentences.en: But RJ had often considered reporting his brother as a suspect for the murders of the two girls.
sentences.zh: 但RJ经常考虑将自己的兄弟举报为这两名女孩谋杀案的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The crimes seemed like something he was capable of.
sentences.zh: 这些罪行看起来像是他有能力做出来的。

sentences.en: RJ couldn't remember exactly when, but around the time of Michelle's murder, Hartman had shown up panicking on his front door in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: RJ记不清具体时间了，但在米歇尔遇害前后，哈特曼曾在半夜惊慌失措地出现在他家门前。

sentences.en: He asked RJ to tell anyone who asked that he'd been there all night, claiming he'd been cheating on his wife and didn't want to get caught.
sentences.zh: 他让RJ如果有人问起，就说他整晚都在那儿，声称自己背着妻子偷腥，不想被抓住。

sentences.en: Gary Hartman refused to plead guilty, but his attorney did strike another kind of deal with the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 加里·哈特曼拒绝承认有罪，但他的辩护律师确实与控方达成了一种不同的协议。

sentences.en: Hartman would waive his right to a jury trial and have a bench trial instead.
sentences.zh: 哈特曼将放弃陪审团审判的权利，转而接受法官独任审判。

sentences.en: This meant the verdict would be decided by a judge, assuring a guilty conviction while still allowing
sentences.zh: 这意味着判决将由法官作出，既能确保定罪，同时又允许

sentences.en: Hartman to plead not guilty.
sentences.zh: 哈特曼作无罪抗辩。

sentences.en: As a consequence of this deal, the prosecution and defence negotiated a sentence of 26 years and 6 months and agreed to certain stipulated facts surrounding Michelle's murder.
sentences.zh: 作为这项协议的结果，控辩双方商定判处26年零6个月的监禁，并就围绕米歇尔谋杀案的某些既定事实达成一致。

sentences.en: One of these facts was that Hartman's semen had been found on Michelle's body, though the first degree rape charge against him was dropped.
sentences.zh: 其中一个事实是，在米歇尔的尸体上发现了哈特曼的精液，不过针对他的他的一级强奸指控被撤销了。

sentences.en: Hartman did not provide any details as to why or how he had approached and attacked Michelle.
sentences.zh: 哈特曼没有透露他为何以及如何接近并袭击米歇尔的任何细节。

sentences.en: In May 2022, Gary Hartman was found guilty of the first degree murder of Michelle Welch.
sentences.zh: 2022年5月，加里·哈特曼因谋杀米歇尔·韦尔奇的一级谋杀罪名被判有罪。

sentences.en: Although Hartman's sentence had already been agreed upon, his attorney argued there were mitigating factors that should be taken into consideration,
sentences.zh: 尽管哈特曼的刑期此前已经商定，但他的辩护律师辩称，有应该被纳入考量的减刑因素，

sentences.en: such as the childhood abuse Hartman had been subjected to by both his parents.
sentences.zh: 例如哈特曼从小遭受过双亲虐待的童年经历。

sentences.en: The judge dismissed this, stating that nothing Hartman had experienced prior to 1986 could excuse or minimise his brutal murder of a child.
sentences.zh: 法官驳回了这一说法，并表示哈特曼在1986年之前经历的一切都不能成为他残酷谋杀儿童的借口或减轻罪责。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to the agreed upon 26 years and 6 months in prison.
sentences.zh: 他被判处此前商定的26年零6个月监禁。

sentences.en: Now aged in his late 60s,
sentences.zh: 如今已年近古稀，

sentences.en: Gary Hartman will most likely die during his incarceration.
sentences.zh: 加里·哈特曼很可能会在服刑期间去世。

sentences.zh: 当米歇尔·韦尔奇的

sentences.en: One of Michelle's aunts told the court that the murder hadn't just impacted their family, it had traumatised an entire community.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔的一位阿姨在法庭上表示，这起谋杀案不仅影响了他们的家庭，还给整个社区带来了创伤。

sentences.zh: 米歇尔的妹妹妮可讲述了这起犯罪如何终结了她的童年，给她带来了反反复复的噩梦，并影响了她的其他关系。

sentences.zh: 尽管罗伯特·沃什伯恩被捕是在林赛作为侦探退休之后，但她仍然被允许成为向巴斯蒂安一家透露这一消息的人。
